note: Forest Service campground in hemlock and pine along the southwest shore of 110-acre Laura Lake (electric motors only), with paved roads, a boat landing and a 2.25-mile trail around the lake; the swim beach and picnic area are on adjacent Gordon Lake. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog read. 41 back-in sites (all 30 ft+; 10 and 20 typed tent-only on rec.gov), $15, no hookups, vault toilets, hand pump; 23 reservable in the peak season, rest first-come, 4-day cutoff; season 04-30..10-13 written (2027 rec.gov ends 10-12). Lakeview kept (sites 25-45 m from the shore under continuous canopy; rec.gov tags 17 'Lakefront' - lead). Closed for the season now (normal).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview kept. Every site sits under continuous hemlock/pine/hardwood canopy on Esri imagery. Nearest to the shore: site 7 (45.70441,-88.50628, first-come) ~35 m, 15 (45.70329,-88.50505, first-come) ~40 m, 16 (45.70301,-88.50478) ~45 m, 18 (45.70287,-88.50436, reservable) ~50 m, 13/21 ~60 m. The rec.gov photos of 7 and 15 show the lake through open-floored woods with tree trunks between (filtered view). recreation.gov tags 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13-16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 24, 32, 35, 37 and 38 'Lakefront' - a contrary claim (re-audit lead, upward): under the canopy rule these read as views, but if the reviewer accepts an open forest floor as the apron, site 7 (~35 m, photo shows the shore across open ground) is the best candidate for a lakefront-with-caveat call.
SITE TYPES: recreation.gov types 10 and 20 'TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC' (10 is reservable); the FS size list gives 10 a 45+ ft back-in and 20 a 40-ft back-in. 39 sites take a 23-ft rig either way.
SEASON: FS 'April 30- October 13' (2026); recreation.gov 2027 runs 04-29 (first-come) to 10-12. Written from the FS page.
STATUS: FS page 'Site Closed' - closed for the season (boat landing open). Normal seasonal closure, no status written.

PIN: stored 45.7032,-88.5052 (the FS page's own lat/long) is at the campground's west end near sites 12/17 and the entrance road; the 41-site centroid is 45.70298,-88.50322 (~155 m east). Under 250 m; fine. The rec.gov facility point 45.70419,-88.50678 is by site 6.
